Root cause was a race: the (then) un-debounced save effect persisted transient out-of-range Max HR values as `null` mid-typing, which re-emitted `currentUser`, which re-keyed `remember(currentUser)` and clobbered both the rider's in-progress input and the just-derived LTHR.
